subject: ddl: fix args count for modify column (#58855)
summary: JobVersion1 ModifyColumnArgs now serializes 5 args until `ChangingColumn` is set (then 8), matching rolling-upgrade expectations for older nodes; tests assert v1 RawArgs length for both cases. Checked v1 decoding (`Job.decodeArgs`) is length-tolerant, DDL modify-column uses `ChangingColumn == nil` as the initial-stage signal, and later `upstream/master` retains this gating behavior.
